fit_reason: Although marked private seller, the photos show the truck staged at a dealership lot (sales hours on the window, rows of inventory, auto business signage) and the text reads like dealer copy, so this looks like dealer stock rather than a private owner's sale.
findings: Black paint on the doors, bed sides and tailgate is already glossy with clear, sharp reflections
Chrome wheels and rear bumper look clean and bright
Tires appear dressed and wheel wells look clean
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2021 Ram 2500. The black paint on the tailgate and bed sides already looks sharp and glossy in the photos. If you ever want a mobile detail or a light buff to keep it that way, we come to you, so just let us know if you'd like a quote.
